units.source: DealsService.StartAsync — Deal stored with VersionFor = null (one deal = one cart line or one listing-page request)
POST /{slug}/listings/create (MarketplaceTemplateExtensions) — ListingCreated in a StreamAction.Start; one listing = one started stream; app = the stream tenant
POST /{slug}/listings/{id}/offers (MarketplaceTemplateExtensions) — OfferSubmitted in a StreamAction.Start; one offer = one started stream; app = the stream tenant

POST /{slug}/support/open and POST /{slug}/listings/{id}/report (MarketplaceTemplateExtensions) — TicketCreated in a StreamAction.Start; a count of opened tickets, not support minutes; app = the stream tenant
PlanSubscribeService.SubscribeAsync — SubscriptionCreated in a StreamAction.Start (a member granted a store plan); app = the stream tenant

POST /admin/tenants/create, the studio create door (StudioTierService.RecordStoreBuiltAsync), the agent's create tool and the boot seeders — Tenant in Inserts; app = Tenant.Id; entrepreneur = Tenant.OwnerUserId
StudioAuth.VerifyAsync — StudioUser stored with VersionFor = null (an entrepreneur's first sign-in to the studio); app = _platform; entrepreneur = the account
AuthHandlers.GetOrCreateUserAsync — User stored with VersionFor = null (a member's first sign-in to a store); app = the session tenant; source = a pseudonym of User.Id
ReviewsService.SubmitAsync — Review in Inserts; app = the session tenant; source = the review id

POST /{slug}/chats/{conversationId}/send (MarketplaceTemplateExtensions) and the sample conversations of the test and appearance seeders — Message in Inserts (one message = one send); app = the session tenant; source = the message id

TwilioSmsChannel.SendOtpAsync through ProviderHttp — one entry when Twilio answers 2xx; request id = the attempt id (store door, AuthHandlers.RequestPhoneOtpHandler) or a fresh call id (studio door StudioAuth.SendPhoneCodeAsync, contact codes AccountContacts); app = the store slug or _platform

TwilioSmsChannel.SendNoticeAsync through ProviderHttp — one entry when Twilio answers 2xx; request id = the notification id written before the send (AccountContacts.NoticeLinkedAsync); app = the store slug
